question.text:
Match List I with List II
\(\begin{array}{|l|l|l|l|}
\hline & \text{List - I} & & \text{List - II} \\
& \text{(Hybridization)} & & \text{(Orientation in Space)} \\
\hline \text { A. } & \mathrm{sp}^3 & \text { I. } & \text { Trigonal bipyramidal } \\
\hline \text { B. } & \mathrm{dsp}^2 & \text { II. } & \text { Octahedral } \\
\hline \text { C. } & \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d} & \text { III. } & \text { Tetrahedral } \\
\hline \text { D. } & \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d}^2 & \text { IV. } & \text { Square planar } \\
\hline
\end{array}\)
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

solution.text: $\begin{array}{ll}\mathrm{sp}^3 \rightarrow & \text { Tetrahedral } \\ \mathrm{dsp}^2 \rightarrow & \text { Square planar } \\ \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d} \rightarrow & \text { Trigonal Bipyramidal } \\ \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d}^2 \rightarrow & \text { Octahedral }\end{array}$
